A few things
you might be brewing on.

Good questions are kind of our thing. Here are a few to get you started.

Do I need to know anything about espresso?

Just that you enjoy it. Your coach starts with your experience and your goals, whether you’re new to espresso or already weighing every shot. We build the fundamentals first, then follow your curiosity.

What equipment will I get?

Your rental includes a premium espresso machine, a precision burr grinder, a compact home roaster, a scale, and essential brewing tools. We match the setup to your counter space and experience during onboarding; specific models depend on availability. Photos show the craft and are illustrative.

How does the coaching work?

You’ll meet your dedicated coach during your home setup, then have one personal coaching session each month. Sessions can be in person or virtual, depending on the lesson and your schedule. Your six-month plan covers espresso fundamentals, home roasting, tasting, and repeatable recipes.

Why a six-month membership?

Six months gives you time to work through different coffees, practice roasting, and build skills that stick. The commitment is six monthly payments of $200, for $1,200 total, with equipment rental, coaching, coffee kits, local delivery, and routine maintenance included.

What happens at the end of six months?

Return your rental equipment with our included local pickup, or talk with us about continuing. There is no automatic renewal. Your roast notes, recipes, and hard-earned coffee knowledge are yours to keep.

Can I roast coffee in my kitchen?

We check your space during onboarding and help you choose a suitable, well-ventilated location for the home roaster. Roasting produces heat, aroma, and some smoke, so a safe setup matters. Your first roast is guided, including ventilation, cleaning, and everyday care.

Your next great coffee has your name on it.
